_comment: Data file for the generated ConformanceTests.testConformance data-driven harness (its default path: tests/sdk-conformance/cases.json, CONFORMANCE_SUITE env overrides). Committed EMPTY on purpose (bead pdfswift-3307a377): the harness's per-method helpers drive this SDK's generated methods against a real binary, and until the generator converges with the pdftract CLI (proposal pdfswift-ccccb2ff) every one of those argv shapes dies in clap against the release binary — any non-empty case list would be a permanently red suite. The absence of a suite file makes testConformance XCTSkip even in provisioned runs, which scripts/e2e-binary-verification.sh refuses: its zero-skip demand treats any skip as a provisioning failure. An empty suite keeps that invariant clean while the real per-operation coverage lives in the hand-written binary-gated suites (DocumentedApiConformanceTests, ExtractStreamConformanceTests). Populate cases only after codegen converges; each case then drives its method through the SDK exactly as a consumer would.
